symptom: create or modify workflow of its own describe output renames Studio Pro's implicit activities: start1 -> Start, end1 -> End, an event sub-process end2 -> End2
cause: describe prints no name for the implicit start/end, branch ends, jumps or end-of-path markers, and the rebuild names them from captions
fix: Pair declared and stored flows structurally (named activities by name, unnamed ones by type ordinal, nested flows by position, event sub-processes by name) and carry the stored names before deduplication
insight: Carry before the CE0495 deduplication, not after, so the carried names take part in it; pair nested flows with nil slots kept, because the rebuild leaves an empty outcome's flow nil where the stored one is an empty Flow
